solutions.title: Mirror DFS
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Helper compares two nodes as mirrors: vals equal and outer/inner children pair recursively.

**Why preferred:** Clear mirror invariant; handles empty root safely.

solutions.title: Mirror recursion on left/right
solutions.description:
**Approach:** `validateLeftAndRight` compares left/right as mirrors (left.left↔right.right, left.right↔right.left).

**vs recommended:** Same core idea. Guard `root === null` (or empty children) before reading `root.left`/`root.right` so empty trees don’t throw.
